segments.cnd17:2.3: Paṭhamenapi jhānena jhāyī, dutiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, tatiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, catutthenapi jhānena jhāyī, savitakkasavicārenapi jhānena jhāyī, avitakkavicāramattenapi jhānena jhāyī, avitakkaavicārenapi jhānena jhāyī, sappītikenapi jhānena jhāyī, nippītikenapi jhānena jhāyī, sātasahagatenapi jhānena jhāyī, upekkhāsahagatenapi jhānena jhāyī, suññatenapi jhānena jhāyī, animittenapi jhānena jhāyī, appaṇihitenapi jhānena jhāyī, lokiyenapi jhānena jhāyī, lokuttarenapi jhānena jhāyī jhānarato ekattamanuyutto sadatthagarukoti –
segments.cnd17:2.5: Virajanti rāgo rajo, doso rajo, moho rajo, kodho rajo, upanāho rajo … pe … sabbākusalābhisaṅkhārā rajā.
segments.cnd17:2.6: Te rajā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd17:2.7: Tasmā buddho arajo virajo nirajo rajāpagato rajavippahīno rajavippayutto sabbarajavītivatto.
segments.cnd17:3.1: Rāgo rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati,
segments.cnd17:4.1: Doso rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati,
segments.cnd17:5.1: Moho rajo na ca pana reṇu vuccati,
segments.cnd17:8.2: Atha vā, bhagavā sabbossukkapaṭippassaddhattā āsīno vutthavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo … pe … jātimaraṇasaṃsāro natthi tassa punabbhavoti.
segments.cnd17:9.4: udayoti tassa brāhmaṇassa nāmaṃ … pe … abhilāpoti –
segments.cnd17:10.1: Katakiccaṃ anāsavanti buddhassa bhagavato kiccākiccaṃ karaṇīyākaraṇīyaṃ pahīnaṃ ucchinnamūlaṃ tālāvatthukataṃ anabhāvaṃkataṃ āyatiṃ anuppādadhammaṃ.
segments.cnd17:11.1: Yassa ca visatā [yassa paripatā (syā.) passa mahāni.202] natthi,
segments.cnd17:12.4: Te āsavā buddhassa bhagavato pahīnā ucchinnamūlā tālāvatthukatā anabhāvaṃkatā āyatiṃ anuppādadhammā.
segments.cnd17:13.1: Pāraguṃ sabbadhammānanti bhagavā sabbadhammānaṃ abhiññāpāragū pariññāpāragū pahānapāragū bhāvanāpāragū sacchikiriyāpāragū samāpattipāragū.
segments.cnd17:13.2: Abhiññāpāragū sabbadhammānaṃ, pariññāpāragū sabbadukkhānaṃ, pahānapāragū sabbakilesānaṃ, bhāvanāpāragū catunnaṃ maggānaṃ, sacchikiriyāpāragū nirodhassa, samāpattipāragū sabbasamāpattīnaṃ.
segments.cnd17:13.7: So pāragato pārappatto antagato antappatto koṭigato koṭippatto pariyantagato pariyantappatto vosānagato vosānappatto tāṇagato tāṇappatto leṇagato leṇappatto saraṇagato saraṇappatto abhayagato abhayappatto accutagato accutappatto amatagato amatappatto nibbānagato nibbānappatto.
segments.cnd17:13.8: So vuttavāso ciṇṇacaraṇo … pe … jātimaraṇasaṃsāro natthi tassa punabbhavoti –
segments.cnd17:14.1: Atthi pañhena āgamanti pañhena atthiko āgatomhi, pañhaṃ pucchitukāmo āgatomhi, pañhaṃ sotukāmo āgatomhīti, evampi atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
segments.cnd17:14.2: Atha vā, pañhatthikānaṃ pañhaṃ pucchitukāmānaṃ pañhaṃ sotukāmānaṃ āgamanaṃ abhikkamanaṃ upasaṅkamanaṃ payirupāsanaṃ atthīti, evampi atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
segments.cnd17:14.3: Atha vā, pañhāgamo tuyhaṃ atthi, tvampi pahu tvamasi alamatto mayā pucchitaṃ kathetuṃ visajjetuṃ, vahassetaṃ bhāranti, evampi atthi pañhena āgamaṃ.
segments.cnd17:15.2: Arahattavimokkhaṃ pabrūhi ācikkhāhi desehi paññapehi paṭṭhapehi vivarāhi vibhajāhi uttānīkarohi pakāsehīti –
segments.cnd17:16.1: Avijjāya pabhedananti avijjāya bhedanaṃ pabhedanaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhaṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:19.2: Chandoti yo kāmesu kāmacchando kāmarāgo kāmanandī kāmataṇhā kāmasineho kāmapipāsā kāmapariḷāho kāmamucchā kāmajjhosānaṃ kāmogho kāmayogo kāmupādānaṃ kāmacchandanīvaraṇaṃ.
segments.cnd17:19.3: Pahānaṃ kāmacchandānanti kāmacchandānaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:19.7: Bhagavāti gāravādhivacanametaṃ … pe … sacchikā paññatti, yadidaṃ bhagavāti –
segments.cnd17:20.2: Domanassāti yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ, cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā.
segments.cnd17:20.3: Domanassāna cūbhayanti kāmacchandassa ca domanassassa ca ubhinnaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:21.2: Thinanti yā cittassa akalyatā akammaññatā olīyanā sallīyanā līnā līyanā līyitattaṃ thinaṃ thiyanā [thīnaṃ thīyanā (syā.)] thiyitattaṃ cittassa.
segments.cnd17:21.3: Panūdananti thinassa ca panūdanaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:22.2: Kukkuccanti hatthakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, pādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ, hatthapādakukkuccampi kukkuccaṃ.
segments.cnd17:22.5: Yaṃ evarūpaṃ kukkuccaṃ kukkuccāyanā kukkuccāyitattaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho, idaṃ vuccati kukkuccaṃ.
segments.cnd17:22.6: Api ca, dvīhi kāraṇehi uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho –
segments.cnd17:22.8: Kathaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho?
segments.cnd17:22.9: “Kataṃ me kāyaduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me kāyasucaritan”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.cnd17:22.10: “Kataṃ me vacīduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me vacīsucaritan”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.11: “kataṃ me manoduccaritaṃ, akataṃ me manosucaritan”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.12: “kato me pāṇātipāto, akatā me pāṇātipātā veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.13: “kataṃ me adinnādānaṃ, akatā me adinnādānā veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.14: “kato me kāmesumicchācāro, akatā me kāmesumicchācārā veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.15: “kato me musāvādo, akatā me musāvādā veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.16: “katā me pisuṇā vācā [pisuṇavācā (ka.)], akatā me pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.17: “katā me pharusā vācā, akatā me pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.18: “kato me samphappalāpo, akatā me samphappalāpā veramaṇī”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.19: “katā me abhijjhā, akatā me anabhijjhā”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.20: “kato me byāpādo, akato me abyāpādo”ti … pe …
segments.cnd17:22.21: “katā me micchādiṭṭhi, akatā me sammādiṭṭhī”ti, uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.cnd17:22.22: Evaṃ katattā ca akatattā ca uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.cnd17:23.1: Atha vā,“sīlesumhi aparipūrakārī”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho;
segments.cnd17:23.6: “abhāvitā me cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti, cattāro sammappadhānāti cattāro iddhipādāti, pañcindriyānīti, pañca balānīti, satta bojjhaṅgāti, ariyo aṭṭhaṅgiko maggo”ti …
segments.cnd17:23.7: “dukkhaṃ me apariññātaṃ, samudayo me appahīno, maggo me abhāvito, nirodho me asacchikato”ti uppajjati kukkuccaṃ cetaso vippaṭisāro manovilekho.
segments.cnd17:24.1: Kukkuccānaṃ nivāraṇanti kukkuccānaṃ āvaraṇaṃ nīvaraṇaṃ pahānaṃ upasamaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:27.2: Upekkhāti yā catutthe jhāne upekkhā upekkhanā ajjhupekkhanā cittasamatā [cittasamatho (syā.) mahāni.207] cittappassaddhatā majjhattatā cittassa.
segments.cnd17:27.3: Satīti yā catutthe jhāne upekkhaṃ ārabbha sati anussati … pe … sammāsati.
segments.cnd17:27.4: Upekkhāsatisaṃsuddhanti catutthe jhāne upekkhā ca sati ca suddhā honti visuddhā saṃsuddhā parisuddhā pariyodātā anaṅgaṇā vigatūpakkilesā mudubhūtā kammaniyā ṭhitā āneñjappattāti –
segments.cnd17:28.2: So ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamo hoti aññāvimokkhassāti, evampi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ.
segments.cnd17:28.4: Sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamo hoti aññāvimokkhassāti, evampi dhammatakkapurejavaṃ.
segments.cnd17:28.5: Atha vā, dhammatakko vuccati catunnaṃ maggānaṃ pubbabhāgavipassanā.
segments.cnd17:28.6: Sā ādito hoti, purato hoti, pubbaṅgamo hoti aññāvimokkhassāti –
segments.cnd17:29.2: Arahattavimokkhaṃ pabrūmi ācikkhāmi desemi paññapemi paṭṭhapemi vivarāmi vibhajāmi uttānīkaromi pakāsemīti –
segments.cnd17:30.2: Avijjāti dukkhe aññāṇaṃ … pe … avijjā moho akusalamūlaṃ.
segments.cnd17:30.3: Pabhedananti avijjāya pabhedanaṃ pahānaṃ vūpasamaṃ paṭinissaggaṃ paṭippassaddhiṃ amataṃ nibbānanti –
segments.cnd17:33.1: Kiṃsu saṃyojano lokoti lokassa saṃyojanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso.
segments.cnd17:33.2: Kena loko yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto laggo laggito palibuddhoti –
segments.cnd17:34.1: Kiṃsu tassa vicāraṇanti kiṃsu tassa cāraṇaṃ vicāraṇaṃ paṭivicāraṇaṃ.
segments.cnd17:34.4: Kissassa vippahānena nibbānaṃ iti vuccatīti kissassa vippahānena vūpasamena paṭinissaggena paṭippassaddhiyā nibbānaṃ iti vuccati pavuccati kathīyati bhaṇīyati dīpīyati voharīyatīti –
segments.cnd17:39.3: Taṇhāya vippahānena, nibbānaṃ iti vuccati. Nandisaṃyojano lokoti nandī vuccati taṇhā. Yo rāgo sārāgo … pe … abhijjhā lobho akusalamūlaṃ, ayaṃ vuccati nandī. Yā nandī lokassa saṃyojanaṃ lagganaṃ bandhanaṃ upakkileso, imāya nandiyā loko yutto payutto āyutto samāyutto laggo laggito palibuddhoti – nandisaṃyojano loko. Vitakkassa vicāraṇāti. Vitakkāti nava vitakkā – kāmavitakko, byāpādavitakko, vihiṃsāvitakko, ñātivitakko janapadavitakko, amarāvitakko, parānudayatāpaṭisaṃyutto vitakko, lābhasakkārasilokapaṭisaṃyutto vitakko, anavaññattipaṭisaṃyutto vitakko. Ime vuccanti nava vitakkā. Ime nava vitakkā lokassa cāraṇā vicāraṇā paṭivicāraṇā. Imehi navahi vitakkehi loko carati vicarati paṭivicaratīti – vitakkassa vicāraṇā. Taṇhāya vippahānena nibbānaṃ iti vuccatīti. Taṇhāti rūpataṇhā … pe … dhammataṇhā. Taṇhāya vippahānena nibbānaṃ iti vuccatīti taṇhāya vippahānena vūpasamena paṭinissaggena paṭippassaddhiyā nibbānaṃ iti vuccati pavuccati kathīyati bhaṇīyati dīpīyati voharīyatīti –
segments.cnd17:42.1: Kathaṃ satassa caratoti kathaṃ satassa sampajānassa carato viharato iriyato vattayato pālayato yapayato yāpayatoti –
segments.cnd17:43.1: Viññāṇaṃ uparujjhatīti viññāṇaṃ nirujjhati vūpasammati atthaṃ gacchati paṭippassambhatīti –
segments.cnd17:44.1: Bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhumāgamāti buddhaṃ bhagavantaṃ puṭṭhuṃ pucchituṃ yācituṃ ajjhesituṃ pasādetuṃ āgamhā āgatamhā upāgatamhā sampattamhā,“tayā saddhiṃ samāgatamhā”ti –
segments.cnd17:45.2: Tanti tuyhaṃ vacanaṃ byappathaṃ desanaṃ anusāsanaṃ anusiṭṭhaṃ suṇoma uggaṇhāma dhārema upadhārema upalakkhemāti –
segments.cnd17:48.1: Ajjhattañca bahiddhā ca vedanaṃ nābhinandatoti ajjhattaṃ vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti [na ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati (syā.)], abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti;
segments.cnd17:48.2: bahiddhā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti;
segments.cnd17:48.3: ajjhattabahiddhā vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.cnd17:49.1: Ajjhattaṃ samudayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī [idaṃ padaṃ natthi syā. potthake] viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti;
segments.cnd17:49.2: ajjhattaṃ vayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.3: ajjhattaṃ samudayavayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.4: bahiddhā samudayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti;
segments.cnd17:49.5: bahiddhā vayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.6: bahiddhā samudayavayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.7: ajjhattabahiddhā samudayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.8: ajjhattabahiddhā vayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:49.9: ajjhattabahiddhā samudayavayadhammānupassī vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.cnd17:49.10: Imehi dvādasahi ākārehi vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto … pe …
segments.cnd17:50.1: Atha vā, vedanaṃ aniccato passanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.cnd17:50.2: Vedanaṃ dukkhato rogato gaṇḍato sallato aghato ābādhato … pe …
segments.cnd17:50.3: nissaraṇato passanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gameti.
segments.cnd17:50.4: Imehi cattālīsāya [dvācattāḷīsāya (syā.)] ākārehi vedanāsu vedanānupassī viharanto vedanaṃ nābhinandati nābhivadati na ajjhoseti, abhinandanaṃ abhivadanaṃ ajjhosānaṃ gāhaṃ parāmāsaṃ abhinivesaṃ pajahati vinodeti byantīkaroti anabhāvaṃ gametīti –
segments.cnd17:51.1: Evaṃ satassa caratoti evaṃ satassa sampajānassa carato viharato iriyato vattayato pālayato yapayato yāpayatoti –
segments.cnd17:52.1: Viññāṇaṃ uparujjhatīti puññābhisaṅkhārasahagataṃ viññāṇaṃ apuññābhisaṅkhārasahagataṃ viññāṇaṃ āneñjābhisaṅkhārasahagataṃ viññāṇaṃ nirujjhati vūpasammati atthaṃ gacchati paṭippassambhatīti –

lines: Terasame udayasutte – aññāvimokkhanti paññānubhāvanijjhānaṃ taṃ vimokkhaṃ pucchati.
Paṭhamenapi jhānena jhāyīti vitakkavicārapītisukhacittekaggatāsampayuttena pañcaṅgikena paṭhamajjhānena jhāyatīti jhāyī.
Savitakkasavicārenapi jhānena jhāyīti catukkanayapañcakanayesu paṭhamajjhānena savitakkasavicārenapi jhānena jhāyatīti jhāyī.
Animittenapīti aniccanimittaṃ dhuvanimittaṃ animittañca ugghāṭetvā paṭiladdhena animittenapi jhānena jhāyatīti jhāyī.
Appaṇihitenapīti maggāgamanavasena paṇidhiṃ sodhetvā pariyādiyitvā phalasamāpattivasena appaṇihitenapi.
Tañhi attūpanibaddhaṭṭhena attānaṃ avijahanaṭṭhena attano paramatthaṭṭhena ca attano atthattā sakatthoti vuccati.
Kiccākiccanti “idaṃ kattabbaṃ, idaṃ na kattabban”ti evaṃ manasā cintetabbaṃ.
Karaṇīyākaraṇīyanti kāyadvārena avassaṃ idaṃ karaṇīyaṃ, idaṃ na karaṇīyanti evaṃ karaṇīyākaraṇīyaṃ.
Atha bhagavā yasmā udayo catutthajjhānalābhī, tasmāssa paṭiladdhajhānavasena nānappakārato aññāvimokkhaṃ dassento uparūparigāthamāha.
Tattha pahānaṃ kāmacchandānanti yadidaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ nibbattentassa kāmacchandapahānaṃ, tampi aññāvimokkhanti pabrūmi.
Iriyāpathikacittañhi iriyāpathaṃ sandhāretuṃ asakkontaṃ rukkhe vagguli viya khīle laggitaphāṇitavārako viya ca olīyati, tassa taṃ ākāraṃ sandhāya “olīyanā”ti vuttaṃ.
Thiyitabhāvo thiyitattaṃ, avipphāravaseneva thaddhatāti attho (dha. sa. aṭṭha.1162).
Dhammatakkapurejavanti iminā tasmiṃ catutthajjhānavimokkhe ṭhatvā jhānaṅgāni vipassitvā adhigataṃ arahattavimokkhaṃ vadati.
Arahattavimokkhassa hi maggasampayuttasammāsaṅkappādibhedo dhammatakko purejavo hoti.
Avijjāya pabhedananti etameva ca aññāvimokkhaṃ avijjāpabhedanasaṅkhātaṃ nibbānaṃ nissāya jātattā kāraṇopacārena “avijjāya pabhedanan”ti brūmīti.
Yā catutthe jhāne upekkhāti ettha upapattito ikkhatīti upekkhā, samaṃ passati apakkhapatitā hutvā passatīti attho.
Evaṃ avijjāpabhedavacanena vuttaṃ nibbānaṃ sutvā “taṃ kissa vippahānena vuccatī”ti pucchanto “kiṃsu saṃyojano”ti gāthamāha.
Idāni tassa nibbānassa maggaṃ pucchanto “kathaṃ satassā”ti gāthamāha.
Evaṃ bhagavā idampi suttaṃ arahattanikūṭeneva desesi, desanāpariyosāne ca pubbasadiso eva dhammābhisamayo ahosīti.
